subject: Renewal & Capacity: Aurora Health — Dedicated pool scale to 32 GPUs
messages:
From: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@aurorahealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Cc: Lina Gomez <lina@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal coming up — need to double reserved pool (16 -> 32)

Neha,

Our renewal window is approaching (Dec 1). Usage at Aurora has increased significantly — nightly inference jobs and peak web traffic mean our current 16-GPU reserved pool is saturated during business hours. We want to renew but increase to a 32-GPU dedicated pool.

Primary asks:
- Can you share a revised reserved pricing (per GPU-hour) for 32 GPUs?
- SLA/throughput guarantees for the expanded pool (p95 latency targets for typical requests)
- Any lead time for provisioning and whether burst capacity will be available during onboarding

Procurement will need an updated quote and SOW for internal approval. I copied Lina from engineering and procurement so we can keep approvals moving.

Thanks,
Sandeep Rao
Director of Platform Engineering
Aurora Health

Attachments: none
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Lina Gomez <lina@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal coming up — need to double reserved pool (16 -> 32)

Sandeep — thanks for the heads-up and context. Happy to get this moving. Key points up-front:

- We can provision a 32-GPU reserved pool for Aurora. Preliminary commercial options are attached (Aurora_Renewal_Quote_v2.pdf) and a draft SOW (SOW_32GPU_Dedicated.docx).
- Revised reserved pricing (indicative):
  * 12-month term: $3.05 per GPU-hour (reserved rate)
  * 18-month term: $2.80 per GPU-hour (reserved rate, greater commitment)
  * Annual prepay (single invoice) gets an additional 4% reduction on top of the term rate.
- Throughput & SLOs: we commit to 99.9% pool availability and target p95 inference latency <= 150ms for up to 512-token requests on the reserved pool (assuming typical Aurora model config). We will validate in pre-prod.
- Burst capacity: you get 20% burst headroom as part of the reserved pool for short-term spikes; additional burst is available at on-demand rates if needed.
- Provisioning lead time: 7–10 business days after signature and account verification.

I attached a milestone-based mutual action plan in Redwood_MA_Plan.xlsx (high level) — outlines validation, cutover, and post-rollout monitoring. If procurement is ready, I can send a DocuSign link for the quote+SOW.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll drop the formal quote & SOW into DocuSign after you confirm term preference (12 vs 18 months).
2) Connor will follow up with an ops migration runbook and tentative scheduling slots.
3) We’ll hold a short tech-check session (30–45m) to confirm model sizing assumptions.

Would you prefer a 12- or 18-month commitment?

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Aurora_Renewal_Quote_v2.pdf; SOW_32GPU_Dedicated.docx; Redwood_MA_Plan.xlsx
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@aurorahealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal coming up — need to double reserved pool (16 -> 32)

Sandeep, Neha — adding a bit more color from the operations side.

- Validation: we'll run a smoke test in your staging environment using a production-like traffic profile (we'll coordinate test tokens/keys with Lina). This ensures we meet the p95 latency target.
- Autoscaling & burst: the reserved pool will be the primary capacity; we recommend enabling autoscale-to-on-demand as a safety net during the first 2 weeks of traffic cutover. That prevents any throttling while caches warm.
- Migration timeline (high level):
  * Day 0–3: DocuSign + account verification
  * Day 4–10: Provision pool and run staging validation
  * Day 11: Gradual cutover (traffic shadowing, then 20% production → 100% over 48 hours)

On pricing negotiation: Neha — if Aurora can commit to an 18-month term and annual prepay, we can lock at $2.80/GPU-hr and guarantee the 20% burst at no extra charge for the first 30 days. For 12 months, the $3.05/GPU-hr is firm.

Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: none
From: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@aurorahealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Cc: Lina Gomez <lina@aurorahealth.com>, procurement@aurorahealth.com
Date: Tue, 28 Oct 2026 10:54:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal coming up — need to double reserved pool (16 -> 32)

Thanks, Neha/Connor. Procurement needs line-item pricing and we prefer to keep the contract to 12 months where possible. Can you confirm whether the $3.05/GPU-hr is fixed for the 12-month renewal and whether the 20% burst is included or billed separately? Also — any flexibility on a modest discount if we sign within this month?

Lina: for staging validation, we can allocate a subset of traffic next week. Procurement, please advise on timeline.

—Sandeep

Attachments: none
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, procurement@aurorahealth.com
Date: Thu, 30 Oct 2026 14:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal coming up — need to double reserved pool (16 -> 32)

Sandeep — appreciate the clarity. Confirmations and a limited concession:

- 12-month option: $3.05/GPU-hr — we can commit to keeping that rate fixed for the 12-month term provided signature and account verification are completed by Nov 12.
- Burst: the 20% burst headroom is included with the reserved pool for short spikes (no separate billing for that baseline burst). Any burst above 20% will be billed at on-demand rates and we’ll provide visibility via per-route metrics.
- Early-signing incentive: if Aurora signs and issues PO by Nov 5, we can offer a one-time invoice credit equal to 3% of the first-month reserved usage (applied as a credit on month 2). This is our limited-time concession to help close timing constraints for procurement.
- DocuSign: I’m ready to send the quote+SOW for signature upon confirmation of the 12-month term. Connor/Evelyn — please confirm provisioning slot availability; Sandeep/Lina — what day next week works for the staging tech-check?

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
